pagination.$description: Page-number row + prev/next arrows + an ellipsis for collapsed ranges. First and last page numbers are always shown as real numbers, never collapsed behind the ellipsis — replaces the jump-to-first/jump-to-last double-arrow buttons the previous ad-hoc implementation had with the same capability (click the visible '1' or the visible last-page number) using one control instead of two. Single size only, unlike button/input/select's sm/base/lg — this is a compact utility control for tables/lists, not something that needs an emphasis ladder. Rows-per-page isn't a separate control here — it composes component.select (sm) directly, see tools/build-pagination-doc.mjs.

item.$description: One shared shape for page-number buttons AND the prev/next arrow buttons — same size/radius/typography, only the content (digit vs chevron icon) and state differ.

ellipsis.$description: Non-interactive — no button chrome, no hover, just muted text marking a collapsed range.

bar.$description: The two pieces (rows-per-page selector, page-range nav) almost always appear together — a table/list footer — not as isolated controls. Full-width: justify-content: space-between (structural, no token needed). Not full-width / inline: this gap is the minimum breathing room between the two groups so they don't crowd each other.

default.$description: Transparent background at rest — not a token value, 'no fill' isn't a semantic color.

hover.$description: Reuses the secondary button's hover fill (gray.200) for the same subtle-gray-on-hover feedback, rather than inventing a new token for what's the same visual intent.

active.$description: The current page — filled solid blue, matching the user's own sketch for this component rather than shadcn's outline treatment.

disabled.$description: Prev arrow on page 1 / next arrow on the last page — no hover, cursor not-allowed.
